[[Ebon Spider Web]]s are the webs spun by [[Lava Spitter]]s, sometimes left behind as [[trophies]] when they are killed.

==Acquisition==
*[[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]
**[[Ring of Fire Islands]]
***[[Lava Spitter]]

===Farming===
;[[Ring of Fire]]
Follow Vizier Khilbron's suggestion to take the mission's back route and avoiding the front door. There's plenty of Lava Spitters. When you get to the first Lava Imp start over because there are no more Lava Spitters afterwards.

==Notes==
*This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Tian]] for his dessert at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival.
